stories.title: WCS Game 1 Series Preview — Boyd vs. King, Petco Park tonight
stories.angle: Series opens tonight — 3 games, all at Petco Park. Boyd vs. King confirmed. Cubs 5-1 vs. Padres in 2026 regular season. Rematch of 2025 WCS.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Cubs at Padres — 3-game Wild Card Series at Petco Park. Game 1 tonight.

Boyd vs. King. First pitch 9 PM CT on Peacock and NBCSN.

Cubs went 5-1 vs. San Diego in 2026. Rematch, new venue, same mission.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Bold take — Cubs have Padres' number (5-1 in 2026 regular season)
stories.angle: Cubs went 5-1 vs. Padres in 2026 (took 2-of-3 at Petco in April, swept at Wrigley in late June). Home field is the Padres' only structural advantage.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Cubs won 5 of 6 vs. San Diego in 2026. Took two of three at Petco in April. Swept them at Wrigley in late June.

This is not a neutral matchup — Chicago has the receipts and the Padres know it.

Rematch. Different stadium. Same result.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Boyd stat breakdown — 2026 All-Star, done this before
stories.angle: Boyd started 2025 WCS Game 1, allowed 1 run in 4.1 IP in Cubs' 3-1 win. 2026: 3.91 ERA, 9-5, 2026 All-Star, 1.14 ERA over 10 straight starts May–July.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
Matthew Boyd started WCS Game 1 last October and allowed 1 run in 4.1 IP in a Cubs 3-1 win.

In 2026: 3.91 ERA, 9-5, 2026 All-Star. Posted a 1.14 ERA over 10 straight starts from May 28–July 22.

He's done this before. Tonight he does it again.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Gausman confirmed on WCS roster — Cubs showing up fully loaded
stories.angle: Gausman IS on the 26-man WCS roster despite nonthrowing shoulder scare. Five starters on the roster. Steele not on postseason roster.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Kevin Gausman is on the WCS roster.

After a shoulder scare and "I don't know" quotes, Counsell got his No. 3 starter on the 26-man. Five starters. Full arsenal.

The Cubs aren't just showing up to Petco. They're showing up loaded.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Brewers await — NLDS stakes if Cubs advance
stories.angle: Winner faces Brewers (No. 1 seed, 100 wins — first time in franchise history) in NLDS. The mountain is real. First: Petco.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Cubs win this series → they face the Brewers in the NLDS.

Milwaukee won 100 games in 2026 — first time in franchise history. They haven't lost to the Cubs in a meaningful series all year.

That's the mountain. But first, there's Petco tonight.

#Cubs #GoCubs #NorthSiders

stories.title: PCA as WCS X-factor — 45 HR, 40 SB, NL MVP
stories.angle: Pete Crow-Armstrong: 45 HR, 40 SB, 10.6 fWAR, age 24. NL MVP. Padres went 1-5 against this lineup in 2026.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong walks into the postseason as the most dangerous player in the sport.

45 HR. 40 SB. 10.6 fWAR. Age 24. NL MVP.

The Padres saw him all year. They still went 1-5 against this lineup. There's a reason for that.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Opponent scouting — Tatis and the Padres are dangerous, and still 1-5
stories.angle: Tatis hit .914 OPS since May 30 (25 HR). Mason Miller closing. The Padres are a real team. Cubs still went 5-1 vs. them.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Tatis hit .914 OPS from June through September. Mason Miller closed games all year. The Padres are a real team.

They're still 1-5 against the Cubs in 2026.

Pre-game read on the opponent is respect, not fear.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #GoCubs

stories.title: Pre-game bold hype — 2.5 hours to first pitch (EVENING SLOT — insights winner)
stories.angle: Countdown to first pitch. Boyd takes the mound. Cubs ended the Padres' season last October. Rematch begins tonight.

x_posts.label: Post 8
x_posts.text:
Two hours from now, Boyd takes the mound at Petco Park and the Cubs' 2026 playoff run officially begins.

Last October: Cubs ended the Padres' season in three games.

Rematch. Petco. 9 PM CT.

Let's do this again.

x_posts.text:
One hour.

Boyd. Petco. Postseason.

Cubs haven't lost a Wild Card series. Not in 2025. Not starting tonight.
